usedFor: Campaign Monitor holds subscriber lists and LeadConnector holds contacts, so “New Subscriber” can feed “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: It adds the contact if new and updates it if it exists, so a returning subscriber is not duplicated.

watchOut: “New Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor is polling, so contacts reach LeadConnector after a scheduled check.
